summary: The registrant, Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc., filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Pacific Century Securities, LLC, as sales agent, establishing an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering. Under the agreement, the company may sell up to $35,280,213.01 of Class A common stock from time to time. Sales will be made under Rule 415(a)(4), with a 3.0% commission to the agent. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a transformative special situation; the filing provides material terms but no pricing, premium, or closing dates. What to watch: future placement notices and share overhang as the ATM is utilized.
